applicabilityBasis.summary: JPYC is the yen-linked electronic payment instrument issued by JPYC Inc. under Japan's funds-transfer framework. The issuer's official repository identifies issuance and redemption through JPYC EX and distinguishes it from legacy prepaid JPYC; the listed canonical contracts match this coin.

genius.notes: JPYC Inc.'s Type II funds-transfer registration (Kanto No. 00099, August 18, 2025) is domestic Japanese authorization, not GENIUS approval. No named U.S. permitted-issuer approval, state qualification, regulator-confirmed application, issuer-announced GENIUS filing plan, foreign-regime comparability determination or OCC foreign-issuer registration was located. Treasury's August 17 proposal gives January 18, 2027 as the expected effectiveness date, subject to the statutory final-rule trigger. The September 30 SCRC interim final rule is procedural. not-yet-restricted describes only GENIUS's phased DASP restriction, not general U.S. legality or authorization. The broad DASP prohibition starts July 18, 2028; the foreign lawful-order condition starts when the Act becomes effective.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Japan FSA confirms JPYC Inc. is a Type II funds-transfer provider, but the opened U.S. materials and bounded named-issuer searches disclosed no GENIUS approval, state qualification, official application or registered foreign exception as of 2026-10-07. Official pending bank-charter lists are incomplete for GENIUS; absence is not proof that no confidential filing exists.
